name: tracker-native-service-entry
goal: Prove configured hub and spoke startup, signed convergence, exclusive ownership, native compatibility and graceful rollback with isolated Tracker processes.

evidence: The pinned CLI forwards normal verbs and does not recognize serve. Configured host startup must select one role, own both listeners and the journal, and refuse legacy autostart.

Rehearsal only exercised an injected runtime. Command cases now require a role and verify that configured ensure fails closed. A disposable process integration exercises the packaged route, signed sync, callbacks, shutdown and leases.
